findings.text: the headless-review-duty skip covers review-ready as well as review-missing, but a tier-none run's duty is built at reckon/crew/obligations.py:1900-1914 by _live_item, which never sets head, so a delivered docs-only run awaiting promotion reads as no work and its session's pane settles for the whole pre-grace window while the obligations view still lists that same review-ready promotion; dea3224b0c held this case, so 1407b3eed3 regresses it.

the scoring exemption condition is restated here rather than shared with the owner's branch at reckon/crew/obligations.py:3126-3139, so a change to the view's exemption drifts from the pane's copy and the two readers this module's docstring promises cannot disagree.

the done_when's clause over the test files importing reckon.crew.station_subscriber or reckon.crew.session_host is measured over two files (tests/test_a_follower_stays_while_a_review_is_owed.py and tests/test_session_host.py) of the 22 test files an AST scan finds importing those modules, and no ruff result is recorded for the staged paths.
